en.title: US Airlines Face October Deadline for New DOT Wheelchair Accessibility Rules
en.summary: The US Department of Transportation has set an October deadline for airlines to comply with new wheelchair accessibility rules, affecting carriers nationwide. Simultaneously, advocates warn that proposed UK benefit cuts could push hundreds of thousands of children into poverty. In other news, Newton City partners with Hear2There to deploy audio guidance tech for visually impaired pedestrians.

zh-TW.title: 美國航空公司面臨十月截止日期以符合新輪椅無障礙規定
zh-TW.summary: 美國交通部設定十月截止日期，要求航空公司遵守新輪椅無障礙規定。同時，英國福利削減方案可能導致大量兒童陷入貧困。此外，牛頓市與Hear2There合作部署音頻導引技術，協助視障行人。
